metadata.title: Read Quran & Track Your Memorization
metadata.description: A focused Quran reader for reading, listening, translation, and tafsir.

hero.intro: A quiet place to read, listen, and reflect
hero.title: Make room for the Quran.
hero.description: A focused reader that keeps the Arabic clear, remembers your place, and brings recitation, translation, and tafsir close when you need them.

tools.title: Everything useful. Nothing between you and the page.
tools.description: The reader stays simple by default and reveals more only when you ask for it.

place.title: Leave and return without losing the thread.
place.description: Read page by page or surah by surah, then continue from exactly where you stopped.

recitation.title: Listen alongside the words.
recitation.description: Play one ayah or keep listening through the surah with your preferred recitation.

meaning.title: Open translation and tafsir without leaving the reader.
meaning.description: Keep the Arabic at the center and bring supporting meaning into view only when needed.

closing.title: Ready when you are.
closing.description: Begin with the first page or choose a surah that is already on your mind.
